GURUGRAM, OCTOBER 30, 2026:  ACME Solar Holdings Limited (ACME Solar) through i ts subsidiary, 
ACME Marigold Urja Private Limited, has signed a Po wer Purchase Agreement (PPA) with NTPC Limited 
(“NTPC”) for a 400 MW Inter-State Transmission Syst em (ISTS)-connected Firm and Dispatchable 
Renewable Energy (FDRE) project under NTPC’s FDRE-0 1 tranche at a tariff of INR 4.37 per unit. 
  
The tariff for this project has been adopted by Cen tral Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC). It 
would be connected to Raghanesda substation on the ISTS network, for which final grant of 
connectivity has been already secured. The Company has already secured a lease more than 800 acres 
of land for this project and is on track for schedu led commissioning as per PPA timelines.  
  
This FDRE project will integrate renewable energy g eneration with appropriate energy storage 
solutions to deliver reliable and dispatchable powe r throughout the day, while meeting the offtakers’ 
power requirements during peak demand hours. It wou ld ensure a reliable supply of renewable 
power, with a minimum annual Capacity Utilisation F actor (CUF) of 40% and an obligation to meet 
90% of the peak power requirement for a cumulative duration of 4.5 hours daily across the morning 
and evening peak hours.. 
  
Following this PPA, the under construction PPA-lock ed contracted portfolio now stands at 4,710 
MW  out of total under construction contracted capa city of 5,380 MW.
